reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #742 ('Refactor lens profile handling') is a generic, multi-part enhancement bounty ($500 USD, Algora) for a large feature program (catalog generation + Lensfun ingestion + selector UI + metadata prefill + calibrator validation + review workflow). It is not a reproducible defect or a single focused code change. It is excluded by the already-competing-pull-request criterion: as of 2026-10-31 there are 23 OPEN pull requests whose bodies reference #742 (GitHub search api total_count=23 on 2026-10-31), namely #1118, #1154, #1155, #1156, #1158, #1167, #1168, #1174, #1192, #1195, #1212, #1213, #1214, #1218, #1221, #1244, #1250, #1252, #1258, #1260, #1261, #1265, #1266. The maintainer AdrianEddy explicitly instructed contributors on 2026-10-11: "please don't submit any more PRs for this issue, there's already way too many of them" (https://github.com/gyroflow/gyroflow/issues/742#issuecomment-6103714841). The bounty rules also state 'Low quality AI PRs will not receive review and will be closed'. Independent contributors report no maintainer review or bounty movement for months (ProspectOre 2026-10-16 https://github.com/gyroflow/gyroflow/issues/742#issuecomment-6226173711 ; ntoledo319 2026-09-24 https://github.com/gyroflow/gyroflow/issues/742#issuecomment-5807631210). Per the classification gate (already-competing pull request / explicit maintainer stop request) the correct outcome is blocked; no competing PR will be opened and the product checkout is left unchanged.
